answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent is paid only after trading with 20 distinct counterparties over a 10-epoch horizon, none above 10% of volume. Each deal carries a cipher-signed receipt, so a sybil ring reusing few partners trips it. Forging 1,000 identities locks 60 POA each, 60,000 total, plus 20,000 fake links, more than any payout. One honest agent pays one 60 POA deposit and earns a saffron seal unlocking earnings in 20 epochs.
